fact_english: The nipa palm's trunk grows underground in the mud; only its leaves and flower stalks rise above the surface.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang nipa, par, sa ilalim ng putik pala tumutubo ang katawan nito.

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Dahon at bulaklak lang ang lumilitaw. Mahiyain na palma.

after_text: Sa dalampasigan, mga isang libo't limandaang mandirigma ni Lapulapu, ayon din sa kanya.
why_here: After the warriors are counted on the shore, before the battle itself is told. Grave episode (a battle): gentle plant fact.
